newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Suspected N.Korean ship seeks help off S.Korea-TV.
newsitem.headline: Suspected N.Korean ship seeks help off S.Korea-TV.

text.p: A suspected North Korean ship flying a white flag was spotted off South Korea's east coast on Tuesday and was apparently in trouble and seeking help, Yonhap Television News reported.
Earlier, South Korean authorities said a North Korean barge was found near an east coast beach where a Northern submarine ran aground last September.
The stricken vessel was sighted close to shore near the east coast city of Kangnung and South Korean investigators had been sent to the area, Yonhap quoted unnamed military officials as saying.
The officials believed the vessel was caught in a storm that lashed the Korean peninsula on Monday night, Yonhap said.
No other details were immediately available.
